تستعلمن (form X)
# تَسْتَعْلِمْنَ (tastaʕlimna) /tas.taʕ.lim.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# تُسْتَعْلَمْنَ (tustaʕlamna) /tus.taʕ.lam.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
